Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
Our gross margin expanded by 72 basis points to 58.0%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2021.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.02 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 72 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
